profile.headline: Software Engineer at Brivo
profile.summary:
I’m the type of person who’s always asking "why?"—an endless curiosity drives me to explore the deeper layers of technology and innovation. My passion for IoT and artificial intelligence fuels this insatiable quest for understanding, and I thrive on unraveling the intricacies of how things work. From an early age, my fascination with computing has led me to pursue a career in computer engineering, where I continuously seek to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Driven by a deep-seated interest in technology and a relentless desire to grasp the underlying principles of innovation, I’m always excited to connect with others who share a similar passion. Whether it's optimizing embedded systems, exploring AI advancements, or diving into the latest tech trends, I’m eager to contribute to meaningful progress and stay at the forefront of technological evolution.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Yocto Project Development: Utilized Yocto Project to design and customize Linux distributions for embedded systems. Developed and maintained custom layers, recipes, and image configurations to optimize performance and ensure compatibility across various hardware platforms. Managed cross-compilation toolchains and tailored kernel settings to meet specific project requirements.

Embedded Web Server Implementation: Engineered an embedded web server to interface with a React-based frontend. Implemented lightweight server software on embedded devices, creating RESTful APIs to enable real-time data exchange and user interaction. This setup provided a seamless web-based control and monitoring interface, enhancing device usability and functionality.

Automated Testing Framework Creation: Developed an automated testing framework to systematically evaluate the diverse behaviors of embedded devices. Designed and executed comprehensive test scripts to validate functional and performance criteria, significantly reducing manual testing efforts and increasing the reliability of device performance

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Directed the management and optimization of the company's manufacturing server, ensuring peak
  performance and reliability in a high-stakes environment.
-Designed and refined a comprehensive suite of hardware tests for embedded devices, including CAN-Bus,
  OSDP, and Wiegand protocols, to rigorously evaluate system functionality.
-Executed firmware updates and meticulously tested I/O interfaces, ensuring relays and other components
  operated flawlessly and met stringent quality standards.
-Oversaw the seamless registration of devices into the server database post-manufacturing, ensuring precise
  data integration and operational success.
-Played a pivotal role in diagnosing and resolving hardware defects, providing critical support to Contract
  Manufacturers (CMs) to streamline troubleshooting and enhance production efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Assisted in designing, developing, and maintaining dynamic and responsive web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
-Contributed to the creation of user-friendly interfaces and enhanced website functionality by implementing features and fixing bugs.
-Collaborated with senior developers and designers to ensure project requirements were met and deadlines were achieved.
-Gained hands-on experience with version control systems, such as Git, and participated in code reviews to improve code quality.
-Conducted testing and debugging of web applications to ensure optimal performance and cross-browser compatibility
